tools.name: bash
tools.description: Execute a bash command (`bash -c`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh shell; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Managed `$DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. rrule.description: Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: "DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1"

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

# Writing Plans

## Overview

Write implementation plans for an engineer who has not seen this codebase or this spec. Assume they write idiomatic code in the project's language once they know the exact interface and the exact test, and that they will make a reasonable choice wherever the plan leaves one open. What they cannot know is what you decided: which files, which names and signatures, which values from the spec, which tests prove each task. Document those. Give them the whole plan as bite-sized tasks. DRY. YAGNI. TDD. Frequent commits.

**Announce at start:** "I'm using the writing-plans skill to create the implementation plan."

**Context:** If working in an isolated worktree, it should have been created via the `superpowers:using-git-worktrees` skill at execution time.

**Save plans to:** `docs/superpowers/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<feature-name>.md`
- (User preferences for plan location override this default)

## Scope Check

If the spec covers multiple independent subsystems, it should have been broken into sub-project specs during brainstorming. If it wasn't, suggest breaking this into separate plans — one per subsystem. Each plan should produce working, testable software on its own.

## File Structure

Before defining tasks, map out which files will be created or modified and what each one is responsible for. This is where decomposition decisions get locked in.

- Design units with clear boundaries and well-defined interfaces. Each file should have one clear responsibility.
- You reason best about code you can hold in context at once, and your edits are more reliable when files are focused. Prefer smaller, focused files over large ones that do too much.
- Files that change together should live together. Split by responsibility, not by technical layer.
- In existing codebases, follow established patterns. If the codebase uses large files, don't unilaterally restructure - but if a file you're modifying has grown unwieldy, including a split in the plan is reasonable.

This structure informs the task decomposition. Each task should produce self-contained changes that make sense independently.

## Task Right-Sizing

A task is the smallest unit that carries its own test cycle and is worth a
fresh reviewer's gate. When drawing task boundaries: fold setup,
configuration, scaffolding, and documentation steps into the task whose
deliverable needs them; split only where a reviewer could meaningfully
reject one task while approving its neighbor. Each task ends with an
independently testable deliverable.

## Step Granularity

**Each step is one action with a checkable result:**
- "Write the failing test" - step
- "Run it to make sure it fails" - step
- "Implement the minimal code to make the test pass" - step
- "Run the tests and make sure they pass" - step
- "Commit" - step

## Plan Document Header

**Every plan MUST start with this header:**

```markdown
# [Feature Name] Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** [One sentence describing what this builds]

**Architecture:** [2-3 sentences about approach]

**Tech Stack:** [Key technologies/libraries]

**Spec:** [path to the spec/design doc this plan implements — the plan
argues from the spec, so the spec travels with it; executors read both]

## Global Constraints

[The spec's project-wide requirements — version floors, dependency limits,
naming and copy rules, platform requirements — one line each, with exact
values copied verbatim from the spec. Every task's requirements implicitly
include this section.]

## Review Focus

[The five input classes or failure modes the spec implies but no task's
tests exercise that are most likely to bite a person using this software
— one line each, naming the input or condition and the behavior a
reasonable person would expect, most likely first. The spec is a vision
document: it says what the software must do, not everything it will
meet, and its silence on an input is not permission for that input to
break the program. Write the list here, once, with the spec in front of
you. Then, for each line, add the test that pins it to the task that
owns the code, in that task's own step style.]

---
```

## Task Structure

````markdown
### Task N: [Component Name]

**Files:**
- Create: `exact/path/to/file.py`
- Modify: `exact/path/to/existing.py:123-145`
- Test: `tests/exact/path/to/test.py`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: [what this task uses from earlier tasks — exact signatures]
- Produces: [what later tasks rely on — exact function names, parameter
  and return types. A task's implementer sees only their own task; this
  block is how they learn the names and types neighboring tasks use.]

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

```python
def test_specific_behavior():
    result = function(input)
    assert result == expected
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Run test to verify it fails**

Run: `pytest tests/path/test.py::test_name -v`
Expected: FAIL with "function not defined"

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement `function(input: InputType) -> ResultType` in `exact/path/to/file.py`**

One line on the approach when the signature and the test leave a choice
(which library call, which data structure); a code block only for an
algorithm they do not determine.

- [ ] **Step 4: Run test to verify it passes**

Run: `pytest tests/path/test.py::test_name -v`
Expected: PASS

- [ ] **Step 5: Commit**

```bash
git add tests/path/test.py src/path/file.py
git commit -m "feat: add specific feature"
```
````

## What a Step Contains

A step is done when the implementer can write exactly one reasonable thing
from it. That is the whole requirement: unambiguous, not complete. Each kind
of step carries what makes it unambiguous and nothing more:

- **A test step:** the test's name and its assertions, as code, with the
  spec's exact values in them.
- **A code step:** the exact signature (name, parameters, return type), the
  file it lives in, and the specific values the spec pins. The implementer
  writes the body. A body appears only for an algorithm the signature and
  tests do not determine, or for exact copy the spec fixes.
- **A verification step:** the command to run and the output that means it
  passed.
- **A reference to another task:** that task's Interfaces block says what
  to use; the plan does not repeat that task's code.

A plan is the set of decisions the implementer cannot make alone. A plan
longer than the code it describes has written the code instead. Lines that
decide nothing ("TBD", "handle edge cases", "add appropriate validation",
"write tests for the above", a type or function no task defines) are the
opposite failure, and the self-review catches both.

## Self-Review

After writing the complete plan, look at the spec with fresh eyes and check the plan against it. This is a checklist you run yourself — not a subagent dispatch.

**1. Spec coverage:** Skim each section/requirement in the spec. Can you point to a task that implements it? List any gaps.

**2. Step scan:** Every step must let the implementer write exactly one reasonable thing, and no step may carry more than that: a line that decides nothing is a gap, a function body the signature and tests already determine is a transcript. Fix both.

**3. Type consistency:** Do the types, method signatures, and property names you used in later tasks match what you defined in earlier tasks? A function called `clearLayers()` in Task 3 but `clearFullLayers()` in Task 7 is a bug.

**4. Review Focus:** For each input class or failure mode the spec implies, is there a task whose tests exercise it? The five uncovered ones most likely to bite a person go in the Review Focus section, and each line there gets its test added to the owning task. An empty section means you checked and found none, not that you skipped the check.

**5. Proportion:** Compare the plan's length to the spec's. A plan several times longer than the spec it implements is a transcript of the program, not a plan. If code blocks are most of the document, replace bodies with signatures, test names and assertions, and check that each step is still unambiguous.

If you find issues, fix them inline. No need to re-review — just fix and move on. If you find a spec requirement with no task, add the task.

## Execution Handoff

After saving and self-reviewing the plan, link it for your human partner
to read. If they have already explicitly supplied an execution method, ask
them to review the plan and confirm it captures what they want; wait for that
review before implementation, then use the preserved method. Otherwise, ask
them to review the plan and choose an execution method before implementation.

**When no execution method has already been supplied:**

**"Plan complete and saved to `docs/superpowers/plans/<filename>.md`. Please review the plan. Which execution approach would you prefer?**

- **Subagent-driven** - A fresh subagent implements each task and a fresh reviewer checks it before the next one starts, then a whole-branch review at the end. Most thorough; costs a fresh context per task and per review.
- **Native** - I implement every task myself in this session, the way this harness runs work, then one fresh reviewer on the most capable model checks the whole branch. Cheapest and fastest; no independent review until the end. Runs well with a mid-tier session model, since the plan carries the design.

**For this plan I recommend <one of the two>, because <one sentence from the plan: how much the tasks depend on each other's interfaces, how many there are, what a shipped mistake would cost>. Does the plan capture what you want, and which approach should we use?"**

**When an execution method has already been supplied:**

**"Plan complete and saved to `docs/superpowers/plans/<filename>.md`. Please review the plan. Does it capture what you want?"**

**If Subagent-driven chosen:**
- **REQUIRED SUB-SKILL:** Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development

**If Native chosen:**
- **REQUIRED SUB-SKILL:** Use superpowers:executing-plans
</skill_instructions>

# Brainstorming

You are very good at building. You build what you believe your human
partner wants, and that belief is usually thinner than it feels. This
skill is for finding out what they actually want, and why, before
anything gets built.

People often haven't finished working out what they want. Good questions
help them think it through. When you understand the why, you make the
hundred decisions they never mention the way they would have made them.

## First: What Do You Actually Know?

Before you reply, ask yourself: what do I know about what they want, and
why?

- **Everything that matters is in the request** ("make the icon cornflower
  blue"). This is a quick, clear task. Do it, and say what you did.
- **Something non-trivial is missing.** Start the conversation.

## Your First Message

Your first message is two things, in this order:

1. One line letting them know that if they'd rather skip the questions and
   have you just start, they can say so. If they take you up on it, this
   skill is done: state any significant how-it-gets-made choice
   (platform, language, medium) in one plain line, then do what they
   asked through the normal workflow.
2. One open question that gets them describing. Ask about a real moment
   or a concrete picture: "What's the moment you find yourself wishing
   this existed?" or "Tell me about the people who'll be in the room."

That's the whole message.

## The Conversation

Each message ends with one question: a single sentence with no list of
example answers hanging off it. Use plain language, pitched just a little
above where your human partner is. Match their vocabulary; never use
process jargon.

Be clear and concise. Lead with what matters. Avoid jargon. When you
report what you found, give them the most important findings and offer
the rest.

**Get them describing.** Open questions come first. Their own words carry
intent that your options can't. Offer a short menu only when they're
stuck. When they say "just guess" or "what do you think?", propose
something concrete.

**How it gets made.** Every project rests on choices about medium, tools,
materials, and resources: the platform, programming language, and
libraries for an app; the medium for a piece of art. Find out early which
of those choices they want to make, which they're handing to you, and what
they already have to work with. Someone with strong views or skills will
want to talk it through. Someone counting on you needs sensible defaults,
said in plain words. When there's existing work, build on what it already
uses. Any choice you make goes in the design as your call, never as
something they agreed to.

**Ground to cover.** This is territory, not a script. Never read these
out as questions:

- what kind of thing this is, and what makes it special
- why now, and what success looks like to them
- goals, non-goals, and anti-goals (what would make this a failure even
  if it technically works)
- prior art: what they've seen elsewhere, loved or hated
- current state: what exists now, what they've tried
- the details they care about

**Questions that work** anchor in specifics: "Walk me through the last
time...", "If it could only do one of these well, which?", "What would
make you wince if I got it wrong?" A guess they can correct ("I'm
guessing this is because X keeps biting you?") often beats a question.

**Offer recon.** Once you have a bit of grounding and looking would help,
offer to go look: their codebase or project, their own files and data,
or the web. Say what you'd look for. They decide whether you go.

**Think wide privately.** Before you propose anything, come up with
several ideas and drop the weak ones, including any that fight what
they've told you about why. Show the comparison only when it helps them
decide.

**Show, don't tell.** Offer the visual companion (below) whenever seeing
would help more than reading:

- something they'll look at: a screen, a page, a printout, a sign
- a layout or arrangement: of a screen, a room, a schedule
- a flow or a sequence of steps
- options that would look different from each other
- a structure that's easier to see than read: a diagram, a timeline, a map

Once they've accepted, use it for mockups to react to, side-by-side
options, and throwaway prototypes they can click.

**Spike to feel things out.** Agentic work is waterfall, but very, very
fast. A quick throwaway build is often the cheapest way to learn what
they want or whether something works. Offer one when it would help.
When they just want to spike, get out of the way. Spikes get no tests
or minimal ones, aren't bulletproof, and skip the plan, implementation,
and review process. Bring what the spike taught you back into the
conversation.

## Play It Back

Play back as you go. As soon as you understand one part well enough to
describe it (what it's for and who it serves, say, or how one piece
behaves), describe that part back in about 200-300 words, then return to
questions about the next part. Playback and questions alternate through
the whole conversation; the last chunk covers whatever is left.

Mark anything you're guessing as your guess; only what they said goes in
as theirs. End each chunk by asking what's wrong or missing.

Before you send a chunk, check it: does it describe something they'll
look at, like a page, a screen, a schedule, or a printout? If so, and
they haven't seen the visual companion offer yet, send the offer instead
(its own message, below) and hold the chunk for the next message. Once
they've accepted, put a mockup next to the description.

## Size the Work

Once you understand what they want, pick a size and say it in plain
words. They can override it.

| Size | The full description | Then |
|------|----------------------|------|
| A quick, clear task | the request itself | do it |
| A small change | in chat | build it through the normal workflow |
| A project with a written design | a written design document | a full plan (for software: superpowers:writing-plans) |

If it grows mid-task, stop, say so, and step up a size.

If this is really several independent projects, say so, agree on an
order, and brainstorm them one at a time.

## The Written Design

For a project, write a plain document a talented builder in the domain
could plan from without going back to your human partner. Cover:

- intent and the why
- goals, non-goals, anti-goals
- constraints
- the parts of the how they decided, as they decided them
- what's left to the builder

**Where it goes:** in a software repo,
`docs/superpowers/specs/YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>-design.md`, committed.
Otherwise, ask. Your human partner's preferences override both.

**Builder check:** dispatch a fresh subagent with
`builder-check-prompt.md` in this directory. When you tell your human
partner you're writing it up, say a reviewer will read it first and you
may come back once with a few questions. Don't hand over the document
until the check is back. Sort what the builder asks into three piles:

- **Answered already** by the conversation or the project: put the answer
  in the document.
- **Minor:** a sensible builder could settle it without changing what gets
  built. Settle it yourself and mark it in the document as your call.
- **Theirs:** only your human partner can answer it, and the answer changes
  what gets built.

Bring the "theirs" pile in one message, most important first. Update the
document with their answers, then hand it over with a short list of the
calls you made so they can check those while reading. That's the only
round of questions the check produces. Without a subagent tool, read the
document as that builder yourself.

<HARD-GATE>
Nothing gets built until your human partner approves the full
description: in chat for a small change, the document for a project.
Building includes writing product code, scaffolding, installing
dependencies, creating projects, and invoking an implementation skill.
Reading and exploring are fine.

Two exceptions. If they opted out of the questions, the skill is done
and the gate goes with it. A spike they said yes to may be built; it
stays labeled throwaway, and keeping what it produced is a new request
that comes back through this gate.

After a project's document is approved, the next step is the plan. For
software, invoke superpowers:writing-plans and no other skill.
</HARD-GATE>

## Red Flags

| Thought | Reality |
|---------|---------|
| "I'll offer options to save them effort" | Options steer. Ask them to describe it first. |
| "I'll fill in sensible defaults" | Good. Say them out loud. A default they never heard is one they couldn't reject. |
| "I should explain the process first" | Ask your question. The process shows itself. |
| "They said 'sounds good' to the idea" | Approval covers what you showed them. A description you haven't written isn't approved. |
| "The spike works, I'll keep building on it" | Keeping it is a new request. Back through the gate. |

## Visual Companion

A browser tab for showing mockups, diagrams, and prototypes. It's a
tool, not a mode: accepting it doesn't send every question to the
browser.

**Offer it just-in-time.** Offer it the first time one of the moments
above comes up, never upfront. The offer is its own message with nothing
else in it:

> "This might be easier if I show you. Want me to open a browser tab with some mockups?"

If they decline, stay in text and don't offer again unless they raise it.

**Per question, ask: would they understand this better by seeing it?**
Mockups, layouts, diagrams, and side-by-side designs go in the browser.
Requirements, scope, tradeoffs, and conceptual choices stay in text. A
question about a UI topic isn't automatically a visual question.

If they accept, read `visual-companion.md` in this directory before
starting the server.
</skill_instructions>
</skill_content>

41: ## 3. M7 契约补齐与安全收口

43: ### 3.1 目标

48: ### 3.2 范围

50: #### M7-1 运行事件回放补 `event` 字段 + SSE 续流端点
51: 
52: **现状**：`GET /runs/{id}/events` 返回的 `RunEventOut` 没有事件名；`payload._event` 被剔除；
53: `GET /runs/{id}/events` 只是分页查询，不跟随实时流；没有 SSE 续接端点。
54: 
55: **契约变更（新增，不破坏旧字段）**：
56: 
57: 1. `RunEventOut` 新增 `event: str`：原始 SSE 事件名（如 `message.delta`、`approval.required`）；
58:    `type` 仍保留分类（run/message/tool/approval/...），`payload` 仍剔除 `_event`。
59: 2. 新增 `GET /api/v1/runs/{run_id}/stream?after_seq=<int>`：
60:    - 鉴权 Bearer；校验 run 所有权（不存在/非本人 → 404，不泄露存在性）；

82:     `PATCH/DELETE /agents/{id}`、`POST /agents/{id}/refresh`、`POST /agents/{id}/health` 改为 admin；
83:   - tasks：`POST /tasks/{id}/cancel|resume|authorize|reject` 改为 admin；
84:   - `GET /agents*`、`GET /tasks*` 保持登录用户可读（全局注册表，v1 语义不变）。
85: - 审计：所有被拒绝的写操作记 `security.rbac_denied`（action/resource/actor），成功写操作沿用现有审计；
86: - 兼容：前端已隐藏管理员入口；普通用户此前可调用，收紧属于**行为变更**，需在 M7 handoff 标注。
87: 
88: #### M7-3 `approval.required` 事件字段补齐
89: 
90: **现状**：事件只有 8 字段；`ApprovalOut` 还有 `tool_display_name/executor/target/side_effect/payload_preview`。
91: 
92: **设计**：事件 payload 增加这 5 个字段（值来自已创建的 `Approval` 行，不新增查询）；
93: `payload_preview` 已是 500 字符截断、`target` 2000 字符截断；字段只增不减，旧前端忽略。
94: 
95: #### M7-4 A2A `authorization_url` 白名单
96: 
97: **现状**：A2A 授权信息在 `app/modules/a2a/tool.py` 的 `auth_required` 分支写入
98: `task.auth_request` 时只截断；`tasks/service.py` 的输出层同样只是截断透传，
99: 没有协议/域名校验。前端只允许 https 与 localhost http，任意 https 钓鱼地址仍可展示。
100: 
101: **设计**：
102: 
103: - 保存时校验：只允许 `https`；`dev/test` 额外允许 `http://localhost`、`http://127.0.0.1`；
104:   拒绝 `javascript:`/`data:`/`file:`/`ftp:`、内网/回环（prod）、超长（>2000）；
105: - 违规处置：`authorization_url=None`（不阻断任务状态），记 warning + 审计 `security.auth_url_rejected`；
106: - 可选配置 `A2A_AUTH_URL_ALLOWED_HOSTS`（逗号分隔；空=任意 https 公网，按当前默认）；
107: - 前端无需改动（已有 https 限制），但会收到更少的可点击链接。
108: 
109: #### M7-5 契约文档与 OpenAPI 同步
110: 
111: - `docs/api.md`：§7.7 增 `event`；§7.8/§10.2/§10.4 改「续流端点」；§8.2 审批超时字段（已在本次修正）；
112: - `docs/openapi.json` 重新导出；`/runs/{id}/stream` 的 SSE 描述与响应头；
113: - 前端 handoff：新增字段/端点/403 行为/续流用法示例；
114: - 相关文档：`README.md`、`docs/roadmap.md`、`docs/architecture.md` 的 M7 状态。
115: 
116: ### 3.3 关键设计决策（待实施时确认）
117: 
118: | # | 决策 | 理由 |
119: |---|---|---|
120: | 1 | `event` 用新增字段，不改 `payload` | 旧前端兼容；`_event` 继续作为内部字段 |
121: | 2 | 续流用 query `after_seq`，不用 `Last-Event-ID` | 与现有分页接口一致；前端重连逻辑已有 `lastSeq` |
122: | 3 | 回放上限 1000 条 | 防止超长 run 一次打满内存；超出让前端用分页接口 |
123: | 4 | 写接口收 admin，读接口保持登录用户 | v1 全局注册表语义不变，只收紧写 |
124: | 5 | `authorization_url` 违规置空而非任务失败 | 远程 Agent 返回的数据不应让整个 A2A 任务失败 |
125: | 6 | M7 不新增迁移 | `event` 是派生字段，RBAC 用现有 `users.role` |
126: 
127: ### 3.4 验收
128: 
129: - [ ] `GET /runs/{id}/events` 每条事件带 `event`，旧字段不变；
130: - [ ] `GET /runs/{id}/stream?after_seq=`：未授权 401、非本人 404、回放+实时、终态关闭、心跳、超限 400；
131: - [ ] 普通用户调用 agents/tasks 写接口 403 `forbidden`，管理员成功且写审计；
132: - [ ] `approval.required` 含 5 个新字段，前端可不再额外拉取审批详情；
133: - [ ] `authorization_url` 恶意协议/内网地址被拒并留审计；
134: - [ ] `docs/openapi.json` 与代码一致（CI contract 绿）；全量测试 ≥ 582 passed；ruff 全绿；
135: - [ ] 前端可按 handoff 接续流与 403 文案。
136: 
137: ### 3.5 依赖与风险
138: 
139: - 依赖：无外部依赖；单实例事件总线（跨实例续流不在 M7）；
140: - 风险：续流端点的所有权校验遗漏会泄露他人 run（用例必须覆盖）；GET SSE 在前端需要 fetch 实现；
141:   回放上限过小会让长 run 需要分页拼接（先用 1000，实测后调整）。
142: 
143: ## 4. M8 管理台后端（原 X2）
144: 
145: ### 4.1 目标
146: 
147: 给前端管理控制台提供真实契约：用户与角色管理、系统项（指令/技能/MCP/A2A）管理、
148: 只读概览；替代当前的运维脚本/DB 配置。
149: 
150: ### 4.2 范围
151: 
152: | 子项 | 端点（草案） | 说明 |
153: |---|---|---|
154: | 用户管理 | `GET /admin/users`、`GET /admin/users/{id}`、`PATCH /admin/users/{id}` | 分页/搜索/status/role；可改 role/status；不能改自己的 role、不能禁用最后一个 admin |
155: | 概览 | `GET /admin/overview` | 用户/会话/run/任务/知识库/存储用量计数 |
156: | 平台指令 | `GET/PUT /admin/settings/instruction` | 复用 `system_settings` |
157: | 系统技能 | `GET /admin/skills`、`PUT /admin/skills/{id}/enabled`、`PUT /admin/skills/{id}/force-disable` | 复用 `skills.scope='system'` |
158: | 系统 MCP | `GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /admin/mcp/servers` | 复用 `mcp_servers.scope='system'`；`secret:` 引用 |
159: | 全局 Agent | `GET/PATCH /admin/agents` | 复用 `remote_agents.owner_user_id IS NULL` 的全局注册表 |
160: | 审计 | `GET /admin/audit-logs`（已有）+ 过滤扩展 | 已有 M5 基础 |
161: 
162: ### 4.3 非目标
163: 
164: - 用户密码重置/强制下线（可后续单独做）；
165: - 多角色 RBAC（v1 仍只有 `user`/`admin`）；
166: - 数据导出/批量操作；
167: - 前端页面本身（在前端 M8 交付）。
168: 
169: ### 4.4 验收
170: 
171: - [ ] 管理员可查用户、改角色/状态，规则（不能改自己、不能禁用最后一个 admin）有测试；
172: - [ ] 系统指令/技能/MCP/Agent 可读可改，`force_disabled` 压过用户覆盖；
173: - [ ] 普通用户访问任何 `/admin/*` 返回 403；
174: - [ ] 关键写操作写审计；`GET /admin/overview` 返回计数；
175: - [ ] OpenAPI/文档/前端 handoff 同步。
176: 
177: ### 4.5 依赖与风险
178: 
179: - 依赖 M7-2 的 `require_admin`；
180: - 预计无迁移（`users.status`、`system_settings`、`scope/force_disabled` 已存在）；
181: - 风险：管理端写操作影响面大，需要「不能把自己锁死」的规则与审计。
182: 
183: ## 5. M9 工作流后端（原 X1）
184: 
185: ### 5.1 目标
186: 
187: 把技能、检索、A2A、MCP 与审批编排成**轻量步骤模板**，可保存、启停、运行、回放；
188: 先做 MVP，不引入外部工作流引擎。
189: 
190: ### 5.2 范围（MVP）
191: 
192: - 表：`workflows`（id、owner_user_id、scope、name、description、steps JSONB、enabled、时间戳）、
193:   `workflow_runs`（id、workflow_id、run_id、status、时间戳）；
194: - 步骤类型（MVP 五类）：`knowledge_search`、`tool`（原生/技能/MCP）、`a2a`、`approval`、`answer`；
195: - API：`GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /workflows`、`PUT /workflows/{id}/enabled`、
196:   `GET /workflows/{id}/runs`；运行入口复用 `POST /chat/stream` 的 `workflow_id` 字段；
197: - 执行：MVP 用「步骤模板注入 system prompt + 工具白名单 + 审批闸门」，不做强制 DAG 调度；
198:   运行事件复用 `run_events`（`workflow.step` 事件在 M9 补齐）；
199: - 前端：X1 升级为 M9 前端，骨架 + mock 升级为真实页面。
200: 
201: ### 5.3 非目标
202: 
203: - planner-executor 子图、并行分支、条件跳转；
204: - 外部工作流引擎（Temporal/Camunda 等）；
205: - 可视化拖拽编排器（前端后续 F 系列）；
206: - 跨用户共享工作流（v1 系统模板 + 用户自建）。
207: 
208: ### 5.4 验收
209: 
210: - [ ] 一个 3 步模板（检索 → A2A → 审批）可保存并跑通，事件可见；
211: - [ ] 取消/失败/审批超时语义与现有 run 一致；
212: - [ ] 步骤类型/顺序/工具白名单校验有测试；
213: - [ ] 工作流运行可在 `GET /workflows/{id}/runs` 查询；
214: - [ ] 迁移可逆（upgrade/downgrade）。
215: 
216: ### 5.5 依赖与风险
217: 
218: - 依赖 M7-1 的事件流（工作流运行态需要续流）；
219: - 先做 0.5–1 天技术 spike：确认「模板注入」能约束主图而不破坏现有工具选择；
220: - 风险：工作流是最容易范围膨胀的项，MVP 必须坚持「不做 DAG/不做外部引擎」；
221:   与主图耦合深，建议独立分支 + 独立审查。
222: 
223: ## 6. 候选池（不占里程碑编号）
224: 
225: | 项 | 触发条件 | 备注 |
226: |---|---|---|
227: | 多实例（Redis 事件总线/共享限流/跨实例 resume） | 出现扩容/多副本需求 | 原「M7 决策」改为需求触发；候选 M10+ |
228: | 通用 `POST /runs/{id}/resume`（ask_user 类） | 需要「向用户追问并恢复同一 run」的能力时 | 当前恒 409 占位；可复用审批的 `Command(resume=...)` 机制 |
229: | 对象存储真实 MinIO 端到端联调 | 启用 `STORAGE_BACKEND=s3` 前 | 当前只有单元测试与注入 client，未对真实 MinIO 验证 |
230: | 知识库语义召回评测取证 | 拿到真实 Embedding key 后 | `KNOWLEDGE_EVAL_REAL=1` 逃生舱已就绪；≥90% 目标未取证 |
231: | 对象存储孤儿文件巡检 | 启用 S3/MinIO 或附件量增大 | M4 遗留，先做对账脚本 |
232: | 上传异步入库 | 大文件 + 真实 Embedding 超时频发 | 状态机四态已保留 |
233: | MCP 连接池 / 复杂 JSON Schema | 高频工具调用或复杂 MCP 工具 | M1.5 遗留 |
234: | A2A 健康巡检 / 轮询退避 | 远程 Agent 数量增大 | M2 遗留 |
235: | MCP stdio 沙箱 | 要开放用户自建 stdio | 默认关闭，启用即信任 |
236: | 消息正文保留策略 | 合规/存储成本要求 | 产品决策，不属技术里程碑 |
237: 
238: ## 7. 排期建议
239: 
240: ```
241: M7（4–5 天）→ M8（5–7 天）→ M9 spike（1 天）→ M9（10–15 天）
242: ```
243: 
244: - M7 与 M8 可部分并行（M8 依赖 M7-2 先落地）；
245: - M9 启动前先做 spike，spike 不通过则回到方案讨论，不硬推；
246: - 每个里程碑独立提交/独立报告，不合并发布。
247: 
248: ## 8. 与前端对齐
249: 
250: | 里程碑 | 前端动作 | 契约来源 |
251: |---|---|---|
252: | M7 | 接 `GET /runs/{id}/stream` 逐字续流；处理写接口 403；审批事件可直接用 5 个新字段 | M7 handoff + OpenAPI |
253: | M8 | X2 升级为 M8：用户/角色、系统项、概览页 | `docs/api.md` §2.12 + M8 handoff |
254: | M9 | X1 升级为 M9：工作流 CRUD/运行/事件；骨架/mock 替换 | M9 handoff + OpenAPI |
255: 
256: > 前端仓库的 roadmap 状态更新由前端会话完成（跨仓库），本立项只保证后端契约与文档。

没有协议/域名校验。前端只允许 https 与 localhost http，任意 https 钓鱼地址仍可展示。
- 保存时校验：只允许 `https`；`dev/test` 额外允许 `http://localhost`、`http://127.0.0.1`；
- 违规处置：`authorization_url=None`（不阻断任务状态），记 warning + 审计 `security.auth_url_rejected`；
- 可选配置 `A2A_AUTH_URL_ALLOWED_HOSTS`（逗号分隔；空=任意 https 公网，按当前默认）；
- 前端无需改动（已有 https 限制），但会收到更少的可点击链接。
#### M7-5 契约文档与 OpenAPI 同步
- `docs/api.md`：§7.7 增 `event`；§7.8/§10.2/§10.4 改「续流端点」；§8.2 审批超时字段（已在本次修正）；
- `docs/openapi.json` 重新导出；`/runs/{id}/stream` 的 SSE 描述与响应头；
- 前端 handoff：新增字段/端点/403 行为/续流用法示例；
- 相关文档：`README.md`、`docs/roadmap.md`、`docs/architecture.md` 的 M7 状态。
### 3.3 关键设计决策（待实施时确认）
| 1 | `event` 用新增字段，不改 `payload` | 旧前端兼容；`_event` 继续作为内部字段 |
| 2 | 续流用 query `after_seq`，不用 `Last-Event-ID` | 与现有分页接口一致；前端重连逻辑已有 `lastSeq` |
| 3 | 回放上限 1000 条 | 防止超长 run 一次打满内存；超出让前端用分页接口 |
| 4 | 写接口收 admin，读接口保持登录用户 | v1 全局注册表语义不变，只收紧写 |
| 5 | `authorization_url` 违规置空而非任务失败 | 远程 Agent 返回的数据不应让整个 A2A 任务失败 |
| 6 | M7 不新增迁移 | `event` 是派生字段，RBAC 用现有 `users.role` |
- [ ] `GET /runs/{id}/events` 每条事件带 `event`，旧字段不变；
- [ ] `GET /runs/{id}/stream?after_seq=`：未授权 401、非本人 404、回放+实时、终态关闭、心跳、超限 400；
- [ ] 普通用户调用 agents/tasks 写接口 403 `forbidden`，管理员成功且写审计；
- [ ] `approval.required` 含 5 个新字段，前端可不再额外拉取审批详情；
- [ ] `authorization_url` 恶意协议/内网地址被拒并留审计；
- [ ] `docs/openapi.json` 与代码一致（CI contract 绿）；全量测试 ≥ 582 passed；ruff 全绿；
- [ ] 前端可按 handoff 接续流与 403 文案。
- 依赖：无外部依赖；单实例事件总线（跨实例续流不在 M7）；
- 风险：续流端点的所有权校验遗漏会泄露他人 run（用例必须覆盖）；GET SSE 在前端需要 fetch 实现；
回放上限过小会让长 run 需要分页拼接（先用 1000，实测后调整）。
## 4. M8 管理台后端（原 X2）
给前端管理控制台提供真实契约：用户与角色管理、系统项（指令/技能/MCP/A2A）管理、
只读概览；替代当前的运维脚本/DB 配置。
| 子项 | 端点（草案） | 说明 |
| 用户管理 | `GET /admin/users`、`GET /admin/users/{id}`、`PATCH /admin/users/{id}` | 分页/搜索/status/role；可改 role/status；不能改自己的 role、不能禁用最后一个 admin |
| 概览 | `GET /admin/overview` | 用户/会话/run/任务/知识库/存储用量计数 |
| 系统 MCP | `GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /admin/mcp/servers` | 复用 `mcp_servers.scope='system'`；`secret:` 引用 |
| 全局 Agent | `GET/PATCH /admin/agents` | 复用 `remote_agents.owner_user_id IS NULL` 的全局注册表 |
| 审计 | `GET /admin/audit-logs`（已有）+ 过滤扩展 | 已有 M5 基础 |
- 用户密码重置/强制下线（可后续单独做）；
- 多角色 RBAC（v1 仍只有 `user`/`admin`）；
- 前端页面本身（在前端 M8 交付）。
- [ ] 管理员可查用户、改角色/状态，规则（不能改自己、不能禁用最后一个 admin）有测试；
- [ ] 系统指令/技能/MCP/Agent 可读可改，`force_disabled` 压过用户覆盖；
- [ ] 普通用户访问任何 `/admin/*` 返回 403；
- [ ] 关键写操作写审计；`GET /admin/overview` 返回计数；
- [ ] OpenAPI/文档/前端 handoff 同步。
- 风险：管理端写操作影响面大，需要「不能把自己锁死」的规则与审计。
## 5. M9 工作流后端（原 X1）
把技能、检索、A2A、MCP 与审批编排成**轻量步骤模板**，可保存、启停、运行、回放；
先做 MVP，不引入外部工作流引擎。
- 步骤类型（MVP 五类）：`knowledge_search`、`tool`（原生/技能/MCP）、`a2a`、`approval`、`answer`；
`GET /workflows/{id}/runs`；运行入口复用 `POST /chat/stream` 的 `workflow_id` 字段；
- 执行：MVP 用「步骤模板注入 system prompt + 工具白名单 + 审批闸门」，不做强制 DAG 调度；
运行事件复用 `run_events`（`workflow.step` 事件在 M9 补齐）；
- 前端：X1 升级为 M9 前端，骨架 + mock 升级为真实页面。
- planner-executor 子图、并行分支、条件跳转；
- 外部工作流引擎（Temporal/Camunda 等）；
- 可视化拖拽编排器（前端后续 F 系列）；
- 跨用户共享工作流（v1 系统模板 + 用户自建）。
- [ ] 一个 3 步模板（检索 → A2A → 审批）可保存并跑通，事件可见；
- [ ] 取消/失败/审批超时语义与现有 run 一致；
- [ ] 步骤类型/顺序/工具白名单校验有测试；
- [ ] 工作流运行可在 `GET /workflows/{id}/runs` 查询；
- 依赖 M7-1 的事件流（工作流运行态需要续流）；
- 先做 0.5–1 天技术 spike：确认「模板注入」能约束主图而不破坏现有工具选择；
- 风险：工作流是最容易范围膨胀的项，MVP 必须坚持「不做 DAG/不做外部引擎」；
与主图耦合深，建议独立分支 + 独立审查。
## 6. 候选池（不占里程碑编号）
| 项 | 触发条件 | 备注 |
| 多实例（Redis 事件总线/共享限流/跨实例 resume） | 出现扩容/多副本需求 | 原「M7 决策」改为需求触发；候选 M10+ |
| 通用 `POST /runs/{id}/resume`（ask_user 类） | 需要「向用户追问并恢复同一 run」的能力时 | 当前恒 409 占位；可复用审批的 `Command(resume=...)` 机制 |
| 对象存储真实 MinIO 端到端联调 | 启用 `STORAGE_BACKEND=s3` 前 | 当前只有单元测试与注入 client，未对真实 MinIO 验证 |
| 知识库语义召回评测取证 | 拿到真实 Embedding key 后 | `KNOWLEDGE_EVAL_REAL=1` 逃生舱已就绪；≥90% 目标未取证 |
| 对象存储孤儿文件巡检 | 启用 S3/MinIO 或附件量增大 | M4 遗留，先做对账脚本 |
| 上传异步入库 | 大文件 + 真实 Embedding 超时频发 | 状态机四态已保留 |
| MCP 连接池 / 复杂 JSON Schema | 高频工具调用或复杂 MCP 工具 | M1.5 遗留 |
| A2A 健康巡检 / 轮询退避 | 远程 Agent 数量增大 | M2 遗留 |
| MCP stdio 沙箱 | 要开放用户自建 stdio | 默认关闭，启用即信任 |
| 消息正文保留策略 | 合规/存储成本要求 | 产品决策，不属技术里程碑 |
- M7 与 M8 可部分并行（M8 依赖 M7-2 先落地）；
- M9 启动前先做 spike，spike 不通过则回到方案讨论，不硬推；
- 每个里程碑独立提交/独立报告，不合并发布。
| 里程碑 | 前端动作 | 契约来源 |
| M7 | 接 `GET /runs/{id}/stream` 逐字续流；处理写接口 403；审批事件可直接用 5 个新字段 | M7 handoff + OpenAPI |
| M8 | X2 升级为 M8：用户/角色、系统项、概览页 | `docs/api.md` §2.12 + M8 handoff |
| M9 | X1 升级为 M9：工作流 CRUD/运行/事件；骨架/mock 替换 | M9 handoff + OpenAPI |
> 前端仓库的 roadmap 状态更新由前端会话完成（跨仓库），本立项只保证后端契约与文档。
| 2026-11-11 | 首次立项：M7 契约补齐与安全收口、M8 管理台后端、M9 工作流后端；多实例移入候选池 |

lines.text: # M7 契约补齐与安全收口实施计划

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.
**Goal:** 补上「事件回放事件名 + SSE 续流端点」，把 agents/tasks 写接口收紧到管理员，补齐审批事件字段，给 A2A `authorization_url` 加后端白名单，并同步契约文档。

**Architecture:** 回放在现有 `RunEventOut` 上新增 `event` 字段（`payload._event` 继续作为内部字段）；新增 `GET /runs/{id}/stream` 复用 `stream_run_events()` 的「回放 + 实时跟随」生成器，路由层先做所有权与回放上限校验。RBAC 复用已存在的 `AdminUser` 依赖（`app/core/deps.py`），只替换 agents/tasks 写接口的依赖并补拒绝审计。审批字段在 `_ensure_approval` 发射处补齐。授权 URL 校验抽独立函数，在 A2A `auth_required` 落库前调用。
**Tech Stack:** FastAPI、SQLAlchemy 2.x async、pytest-asyncio、httpx、sse-starlette 风格手写 SSE（现有 `format_sse`）。
- Python `>=3.13`；ruff `line-length = 100`；注释与用户可见错误消息一律中文。
- 测试零网络、零外部存储；不启动新容器（复用 `dev_postgres`）。
- 每个任务结束时 `pytest -q` 必须全绿；新测试先失败后实现。
- 错误走 `app/core/errors.py` 既有类 + `code` 参数，不自造信封。
- 新增端点必须声明 400/401/403/404/409/500 契约（沿用 `docs/api.md` 错误信封）。
- 提交只在本地，不推送、不删分支（用户偏好）。

1. **续流所有权**：非本人 run 必须 404，不能 403（避免探测）；未带 token 401。

41: class DomainError(Exception):
42:     """可预期的业务异常，必须由 HTTP 层统一转换。"""

44:     status_code: int = 400

49:         message: str,
50:         *,
51:         code: str | None = None,
52:         status_code: int | None = None,
53:         details: dict[str, Any] | None = None,

67:             "request_id": request_id or current_request_id(),

70:         # 需要携带 run_id 等结构化信息时放在 details 里，避免破坏信封形状。
71:         if self.details:

194:         )

220:         message = str(exc.detail) if exc.detail else "请求失败"
221:         return _envelope(exc.status_code, code, message, request_id=request_id_from(request))

2: 
3: 游标只承载排序键，前端不得解析；编码使用 urlsafe base64，避免 URL 转义问题。
4: 
5: 调用方直接把 ORM 字段放进 payload（``last.id`` 是 ``UUID``、``created_at`` 是
6: ``datetime``）。``json.dumps`` 不认识这些类型，历史上会抛 ``TypeError`` 并被
7: 全局异常处理成 500——只要列表需要返回 ``next_cursor`` 就会触发。因此编码层统一
8: 做 JSON-safe 归一化：``UUID`` 转标准字符串、``datetime`` 转 ISO 8601，解码后由
9: 各业务的游标判断再用 ``uuid.UUID(...)`` / ``datetime.fromisoformat(...)`` 还原。
10: """
11: 
12: from __future__ import annotations
13: 
14: import base64
15: import json
16: import uuid
17: from datetime import date, datetime
18: from typing import Any
19: 
20: from app.core.errors import ValidationFailedError
21: 
22: 
23: def _json_safe(value: Any) -> str:
24:     """把游标值转成确定的字符串表示，避免依赖隐式 ``str()``。"""
25:     if isinstance(value, uuid.UUID):
26:         return str(value)
27:     if isinstance(value, datetime):
28:         return value.isoformat()
29:     if isinstance(value, date):
30:         return value.isoformat()
31:     raise TypeError(f"游标值不可序列化：{type(value).__name__}")
32: 
33: 
34: def encode_cursor(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
35:     raw = json.dumps(
36:         payload,
37:         ensure_ascii=False,
38:         separators=(",", ":"),
39:         default=_json_safe,
40:     ).encode()
41:     return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(raw).decode().rstrip("=")
42: 
43: 
44: def decode_cursor(cursor: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
45:     if not cursor:
46:         return {}
47:     padded = cursor + "=" * (-len(cursor) % 4)
48:     try:
49:         data = json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(padded.encode()))
50:     except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
51:         raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效") from exc
52:     if not isinstance(data, dict):
53:         raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效")
54:     return data

53:     return (slug or "skill")[:64]

56: def _skill_out(skill: Skill, *, effective: bool) -> SkillOut:
57:     return SkillOut(
58:         id=skill.id,
59:         scope=skill.scope,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
60:         slug=skill.slug,
61:         name=skill.name,
62:         description=skill.description,
63:         version=skill.version,
64:         source=skill.source,
65:         enabled=skill.enabled,
66:         force_disabled=skill.force_disabled,
67:         effective_enabled=effective,
68:         estimated_tokens=skill.estimated_tokens,
69:         size_bytes=skill.size_bytes,
70:         file_count=skill.file_count,
71:         created_at=skill.created_at,
72:         updated_at=skill.updated_at,
73:     )
74: 
75: 
76: def _require_enabled() -> None:
77:     if not get_settings().skills_enabled:
78:         raise CapabilityDisabledError("技能能力未启用")
79: 
80: 
81: async def _effective_enabled(db: AsyncSession, skill: Skill, user: User | None) -> bool:
82:     if skill.force_disabled:
83:         return False
84:     if skill.scope == "user":
85:         return skill.enabled
86:     if user is None:
87:         return skill.enabled
88:     override = await db.scalar(
89:         select(UserCapabilityOverride.enabled).where(
90:             UserCapabilityOverride.user_id == user.id,
91:             UserCapabilityOverride.capability == "skill",
92:             UserCapabilityOverride.target_id == skill.id,
93:         )
94:     )
95:     return skill.enabled if override is None else override

98: async def list_skills(
99:     db: AsyncSession, user: User, *, q: str | None = None
100: ) -> SkillListOut:
101:     _require_enabled()
102:     stmt = select(Skill).where(
103:         (Skill.scope == "system") | (Skill.owner_user_id == user.id)
104:     )
105:     if q:
106:         pattern = f"%{q.strip()}%"
107:         stmt = stmt.where(Skill.name.ilike(pattern) | Skill.description.ilike(pattern))
108:     rows = list((await db.execute(stmt.order_by(Skill.created_at.desc()))).scalars())
109:     stats = {"total": len(rows), "system": 0, "user": 0, "enabled": 0}
110:     items: list[SkillOut] = []
111:     for row in rows:
112:         effective = await _effective_enabled(db, row, user)
113:         stats[row.scope] += 1
114:         if effective:

116:         items.append(_skill_out(row, effective=effective))

212:         suffix = hashlib.sha256(f"{attempt}".encode()).hexdigest()[:6]
213:         slug = f"{base[:56]}-{suffix}"
214:     skill = Skill(
215:         scope="user",

428: def _exposed_name(slug: str, tool_name: str) -> str:

436: async def _sync_tools(db: AsyncSession, server: McpServer, tools: list[ToolInfo]) -> int:
437:     settings = get_settings()
438:     existing = {
439:         item.name: item
440:         for item in (
441:             await db.execute(select(McpTool).where(McpTool.server_id == server.id))
442:         ).scalars()
443:     }
444:     now = _now()
445:     seen: set[str] = set()
446:     discovered = 0
447:     for index, info in enumerate(tools):
448:         if index >= settings.mcp_max_tools_per_server:
449:             break
450:         if not info.name or info.name in seen:
451:             continue
452:         seen.add(info.name)
453:         risk = _risk_of(info.annotations)
454:         is_system_write = server.scope == "system" and risk != "read"
455:         exposed = _exposed_name(server.slug, info.name)
456:         # 同服务器内 exposed_name 冲突时追加短哈希。
457:         if await db.scalar(
458:             select(McpTool.id).where(
459:                 McpTool.server_id == server.id,
460:                 McpTool.exposed_name == exposed,
461:                 McpTool.name != info.name,
462:             )
463:         ):
464:             exposed = _exposed_name(server.slug, f"{info.name}-{hashlib.sha256(info.name.encode()).hexdigest()[:6]}")
465:         row = existing.get(info.name)
466:         if row is None:
467:             row = McpTool(
468:                 server_id=server.id,
469:                 name=info.name,
470:                 exposed_name=exposed,
471:                 description=info.description,
472:                 input_schema=info.input_schema or {},
473:                 annotations=info.annotations,
474:                 risk=risk,
475:                 requires_approval=risk != "read",
476:                 admin_only=is_system_write,
477:                 user_allowed=not is_system_write,
478:                 enabled=True,
479:                 discovered_at=now,
480:             )
481:             db.add(row)
482:         else:
483:             row.exposed_name = exposed
484:             row.description = info.description
485:             row.input_schema = info.input_schema or {}
486:             row.annotations = info.annotations
487:             row.risk = risk
488:             row.admin_only = is_system_write
489:             row.user_allowed = not is_system_write
490:             # requires_approval / enabled 属于用户策略，刷新时保留已有配置。
491:             row.updated_at = now
492:         discovered += 1
493:     gone = [name for name in existing if name not in seen]
494:     if gone:
495:         await db.execute(
496:             delete(McpTool).where(McpTool.server_id == server.id, McpTool.name.in_(gone))
497:         )
498:     server.tools_synced_at = now
499:     return discovered

502: async def _check_and_sync(
503:     db: AsyncSession, server: McpServer, *, force: bool = False
504: ) -> McpCheckResult:
505:     """执行连通性检查并同步工具缓存；不抛连接错误，统一写回健康状态。"""
506:     settings = get_settings()
507:     if not force and server.tools_synced_at is not None:
508:         age = (_now() - server.tools_synced_at).total_seconds()
509:         if age < settings.mcp_tool_cache_ttl_seconds:
510:             return McpCheckResult(
511:                 id=server.id,
512:                 health_status=server.health_status,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
513:                 latency_ms=server.latency_ms,
514:                 message="使用缓存结果",
515:                 tools_discovered=await db.scalar(
516:                     select(func.count(McpTool.id)).where(McpTool.server_id == server.id)
517:                 ) or 0,
518:                 last_checked_at=server.last_checked_at,
519:             )
520:     started = datetime.now(UTC)
521:     try:
522:         client = await _client_for(db, server)
523:         status, latency, _ = await client.check()
524:         tools = await client.list_tools()
525:         discovered = await _sync_tools(db, server, tools)
526:         server.health_status = status
527:         server.latency_ms = latency
528:         server.last_checked_at = _now()
529:         server.last_error = None
530:         await db.commit()
531:         await write_audit(
532:             db,
533:             actor_type="system",
534:             actor_id="",
535:             action="mcp.server.check",
536:             resource_type="mcp_server",
537:             resource_id=str(server.id),
538:             detail={"healthy": True, "tools": discovered, "latency_ms": latency},
539:             commit=True,
540:         )
541:         return McpCheckResult(
542:             id=server.id,
543:             health_status=status,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
544:             latency_ms=latency,
545:             message=f"连接成功，发现 {discovered} 个工具",
546:             tools_discovered=discovered,
547:             last_checked_at=server.last_checked_at,
548:         )
549:     except Exception as exc:
550:         elapsed = elapsed_ms(started)
551:         message = str(exc)[:400]
552:         server.health_status = "unhealthy"
553:         server.latency_ms = elapsed
554:         server.last_checked_at = _now()
555:         server.last_error = message
556:         await db.commit()
557:         await write_audit(
558:             db,
559:             actor_type="system",
560:             actor_id="",
561:             action="mcp.server.check",
562:             resource_type="mcp_server",
563:             resource_id=str(server.id),
564:             detail={"healthy": False, "error": message[:200]},
565:             commit=True,
566:         )
567:         return McpCheckResult(
568:             id=server.id,
569:             health_status="unhealthy",
570:             latency_ms=elapsed,
571:             message=message,
572:             tools_discovered=await db.scalar(
573:                 select(func.count(McpTool.id)).where(McpTool.server_id == server.id)
574:             ) or 0,
575:             last_checked_at=server.last_checked_at,
576:         )

627:             raise ForbiddenError("系统写工具不能取消审批")
628:         tool.requires_approval = payload.requires_approval
629:     await write_audit(

670: async def collect_chat_tools(

674:     explicit_servers: list[uuid.UUID],
675:     explicit_tools: list[uuid.UUID],
676: ) -> tuple[list[ChatMcpTool], list[dict[str, str]]]:
677:     """按「自动注入 + 显式选择 + 角色过滤」生成本轮 MCP 工具目录。
678: 
679:     返回 (工具列表, 降级 notice 列表)。资源不可见抛 404，已停用抛 422。
680:     """
681:     if not get_settings().mcp_enabled:
682:         return [], []
683:     servers = await _visible_servers(db, user)
684:     by_id = {server.id: server for server in servers}
685:     notices: list[dict[str, str]] = []
686: 
687:     for server_id in explicit_servers:
688:         server = by_id.get(server_id)
689:         if server is None:
690:             raise NotFoundError("所选 MCP 服务器不存在")
691:         if not await _effective_enabled(db, server, user):
692:             raise ValidationFailedError(
693:                 f"MCP 服务器「{server.name}」已停用", code="capability_disabled"
694:             )
695:         if server.health_status == "unhealthy":
696:             notices.append(
697:                 {
698:                     "level": "warning",
699:                     "code": "mcp_unavailable",
700:                     "message": f"MCP 服务器「{server.name}」不可用，本轮其工具可能无法调用",
701:                 }
702:             )
703:     explicit_tool_ids = [str(item) for item in explicit_tools]
704:     for tool_id in explicit_tools:
705:         tool = await db.get(McpTool, tool_id)
706:         if tool is None or tool.server_id not in by_id:
707:             raise NotFoundError("所选 MCP 工具不存在")
708:         if not tool.enabled:
709:             raise ValidationFailedError("所选 MCP 工具已停用", code="capability_disabled")
710: 
711:     selected_server_ids: set[uuid.UUID] = set(explicit_servers)
712:     for tool_id in explicit_tools:
713:         tool = await db.get(McpTool, tool_id)
714:         if tool is not None:
715:             selected_server_ids.add(tool.server_id)
716:     settings = get_settings()
717:     for server in servers:
718:         if server.id in selected_server_ids:
719:             continue
720:         if not server.auto_inject or not await _effective_enabled(db, server, user):
721:             continue
722:         if server.health_status == "unhealthy":
723:             notices.append(
724:                 {
725:                     "level": "warning",
726:                     "code": "mcp_unavailable",
727:                     "message": f"MCP 服务器「{server.name}」不可用，本轮未注入其工具",
728:                 }
729:             )
730:             continue
731:         selected_server_ids.add(server.id)
732: 
733:     tools: list[ChatMcpTool] = []
734:     explicit_only_tool_ids: set[uuid.UUID] = set()
735:     for server_id in selected_server_ids:
736:         server = by_id.get(server_id)
737:         if server is None:
738:             continue
739:         rows = list(
740:             (
741:                 await db.execute(
742:                     select(McpTool)
743:                     .where(McpTool.server_id == server.id, McpTool.enabled.is_(True))
744:                     .order_by(McpTool.name.asc())
745:                 )
746:             ).scalars()
747:         )
748:         for row in rows:
749:             if server.scope == "system" and row.admin_only and user.role != "admin":
750:                 if str(row.id) in explicit_tool_ids:
751:                     raise ForbiddenError(
752:                         f"系统 MCP 工具「{row.exposed_name}」仅管理员可用"
753:                     )
754:                 continue
755:             if str(row.id) in explicit_tool_ids:
756:                 explicit_only_tool_ids.add(row.id)
757:             tools.append(
758:                 ChatMcpTool(
759:                     tool_id=row.id,
760:                     server_id=server.id,
761:                     slug=server.slug,
762:                     exposed_name=row.exposed_name,
763:                     description=f"[{server.name}] {row.description}".strip()[:4000],
764:                     input_schema=row.input_schema or {},
765:                     risk=row.risk,
766:                     requires_approval=row.requires_approval,
767:                 )
768:             )
769:     # 自动注入总量上限：超出时先裁掉未被显式选择的服务器工具。
770:     if len(tools) > settings.mcp_max_auto_tools:
771:         keep_explicit = [
772:             tool for tool in tools if tool.tool_id in explicit_only_tool_ids
773:         ]
774:         auto = [tool for tool in tools if tool.tool_id not in explicit_only_tool_ids]
775:         if len(keep_explicit) > settings.mcp_max_auto_tools:
776:             raise ValidationFailedError("本轮显式选择的 MCP 工具超过上限")
777:         tools = keep_explicit + auto[: settings.mcp_max_auto_tools - len(keep_explicit)]
778:         notices.append(

780:                 "level": "info",
781:                 "code": "mcp_tools_trimmed",
782:                 "message": "MCP 工具过多，部分自动注入工具本轮未加载",
783:             }
784:         )

159: def _infer_auth_scheme(card: dict) -> str:
160:     """从 Card securitySchemes 推断展示用 scheme：bearer / header / oauth2 / none。"""
161:     schemes = card.get("securitySchemes") or {}
162:     if not isinstance(schemes, dict):
163:         return "none"
164:     for spec in schemes.values():
165:         if not isinstance(spec, dict):
166:             continue
167:         scheme_type = str(spec.get("type") or "").lower()
168:         if scheme_type == "http" and str(spec.get("scheme") or "").lower() == "bearer":
169:             return "bearer"
170:         if scheme_type in {"apikey", "api_key"}:
171:             return "header"
172:         if "oauth" in scheme_type:
173:             return "oauth2"
174:     return "none"

186: def _apply_auth(
187:     agent: RemoteAgent,
188:     card: dict,
189:     auth: object | None,
190:     *,
191:     role: str,
192: ) -> None:
193:     """把注册/更新时的 auth 输入落到 Agent；secret_ref 只存引用。
194: 
195:     ``secret:NAME`` 引用平台密钥，仅管理员可配置；普通用户只能用 ``env:``。
196:     """
197:     if auth is None:
198:         return
199:     auth_type = getattr(auth, "type", None) or "none"
200:     secret_ref = (getattr(auth, "secret_ref", None) or "").strip() or None
201:     if secret_ref and secret_ref.startswith("secret:") and role != "admin":
202:         from app.core.errors import ValidationFailedError
203: 
204:         raise ValidationFailedError(
205:             "secret: 引用仅管理员可配置", code="secret_ref_not_allowed"
206:         )
207:     if auth_type == "none":
208:         agent.auth_type = "none"
209:         agent.auth_scheme = "none"
210:         agent.secret_ref = None
211:         return
212:     if auth_type == "oauth2":
213:         agent.auth_type = "oauth2"
214:         agent.auth_scheme = "oauth2"
215:         agent.secret_ref = None
216:         return
217:     # api_key：scheme 优先从 Card 推断，其次默认 bearer。
218:     agent.auth_type = "api_key"
219:     agent.auth_scheme = _infer_auth_scheme(card) if agent.auth_scheme == "none" else agent.auth_scheme
220:     if agent.auth_scheme in {"none", "oauth2"}:
221:         agent.auth_scheme = "bearer"
222:     agent.secret_ref = secret_ref
223:     if secret_ref:
224:         agent.auth_hint = secret_ref

404:         )
405:         .where(A2aTask.remote_agent_id.in_(agent_ids))
406:         .group_by(A2aTask.remote_agent_id)
407:         .subquery()
408:     )
409:     rows = (
410:         await db.execute(
411:             select(A2aTask)
412:             .join(

414:                 and_(

416:                     A2aTask.created_at == latest.c.max_created,
417:                 ),
418:             )
419:             .order_by(A2aTask.created_at.desc())
420:             .limit(len(agent_ids))
421:         )
422:     ).scalars()

4: ``None``，由调用方跳过该凭据头，不向终端用户抛错。
5: """

8: 
9: import logging
10: import uuid
11:

13: from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
14:

17: from app.core.ssrf import decrypt_secret, encrypt_secret
18: from app.db.models.secret import PlatformSecret
19: from app.db.models.user import User
20: from app.modules.secrets.schemas import (
21:     SecretCreateRequest,
22:     SecretOut,
23:     SecretUpdateRequest,
24: )
25: 
26: logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
27: 
28: 
29: def _to_out(row: PlatformSecret) -> SecretOut:
30:     return SecretOut(
31:         name=row.name,
32:         description=row.description,
33:         enabled=row.enabled,
34:         created_at=row.created_at,
35:         updated_at=row.updated_at,
36:     )
37: 
38: 
39: def _encrypt(value: str) -> str:
40:     ciphertext = encrypt_secret(value)
41:     if ciphertext is None:
42:         raise ServiceUnavailableError(
43:             "保存平台密钥需要配置 CAPABILITY_SECRET_KEY",
44:             code="secret_store_unavailable",
45:         )
46:     return ciphertext
47: 
48: 
49: async def _get_by_name(db: AsyncSession, name: str) -> PlatformSecret:
50:     row = await db.scalar(select(PlatformSecret).where(PlatformSecret.name == name))
51:     if row is None:
52:         raise NotFoundError("密钥不存在", code="secret_not_found")
53:     return row
54: 
55: 
56: async def list_secrets(db: AsyncSession, *, enabled: bool | None = None) -> list[SecretOut]:
57:     stmt = select(PlatformSecret).order_by(PlatformSecret.name.asc())
58:     if enabled is not None:
59:         stmt = stmt.where(PlatformSecret.enabled.is_(enabled))
60:     rows = list((await db.execute(stmt)).scalars())
61:     return [_to_out(row) for row in rows]
62: 
63: 
64: async def create_secret(
65:     db: AsyncSession, admin: User, payload: SecretCreateRequest
66: ) -> SecretOut:
67:     exists = await db.scalar(select(PlatformSecret.id).where(PlatformSecret.name == payload.name))
68:     if exists is not None:
69:         raise ConflictError("同名平台密钥已存在", code="secret_exists")
70:     row = PlatformSecret(
71:         id=uuid.uuid4(),
72:         name=payload.name,
73:         description=payload.description,
74:         ciphertext=_encrypt(payload.value),
75:         enabled=True,
76:         created_by=admin.id,
77:     )
78:     db.add(row)
79:     await write_audit(
80:         db,
81:         actor_type="user",
82:         actor_id=str(admin.id),
83:         action="secret.create",
84:         resource_type="platform_secret",
85:         resource_id=payload.name,
86:         detail={"name": payload.name},
87:     )
88:     await db.commit()
89:     await db.refresh(row)
90:     return _to_out(row)
91: 
92: 
93: async def update_secret_by_name(
94:     db: AsyncSession, admin: User, name: str, payload: SecretUpdateRequest
95: ) -> SecretOut:
96:     row = await _get_by_name(db, name)
97:     changed: list[str] = []
98:     if payload.value is not None:
99:         row.ciphertext = _encrypt(payload.value)
100:         changed.append("value")
101:     if payload.description is not None:
102:         row.description = payload.description
103:         changed.append("description")
104:     if payload.enabled is not None:
105:         row.enabled = payload.enabled
106:         changed.append("enabled")
107:     await write_audit(
108:         db,
109:         actor_type="user",
110:         actor_id=str(admin.id),
111:         action="secret.update",
112:         resource_type="platform_secret",
113:         resource_id=name,
114:         detail={"name": name, "changed_fields": changed},
115:     )
116:     await db.commit()
117:     await db.refresh(row)
118:     return _to_out(row)
119: 
120: 
121: async def delete_secret_by_name(db: AsyncSession, admin: User, name: str) -> None:

131:     )

    storage: LocalFileStorage,
    provider: FakeEmbeddingProvider,
    *,
    owner: User | None,
    title: str,
    filename: str,
    category: str,
    text: str,
) -> KnowledgeDocument:
    """按 service 的规则造一篇 ready 文档：原文落盘 + 真实切分 + 真实向量。"""
    settings = get_settings()
    raw = text.encode("utf-8")
    document = KnowledgeDocument(
        id=uuid.uuid4(),
        owner_user_id=owner.id if owner is not None else None,
        title=title,
        filename=filename,
        source_uri=filename,
        category=category,
        checksum=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
        size_bytes=len(raw),
        status="ready",
    )
    document.storage_key = f"knowledge/{document.id}{Path(filename).suffix.lower()}"
    await storage.put(document.storage_key, raw)
    chunks = split_text(
        text,
        size=settings.knowledge_chunk_size,
        overlap=settings.knowledge_chunk_overlap,
        max_chunks=settings.knowledge_max_chunks_per_document,
    )
    vectors = await provider.embed(
        [
            f"{chunk.heading}\n{chunk.content}" if chunk.heading else chunk.content
            for chunk in chunks
        ]
    )
    for chunk, vector in zip(chunks, vectors, strict=True):
        document.chunks.append(
            KnowledgeChunk(
                chunk_index=chunk.index,
                content=chunk.content,
                embedding=vector,
                token_count=len(chunk.content),
                metadata_={**chunk.metadata, "char_start": chunk.char_start},
            )
        )
    document.chunk_count = len(chunks)
    session.add(document)
    return document

async def collect_sse(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient,
    *,
    headers: dict[str, str],
    payload: dict,
    stop_events: tuple[str, ...] = ("message.done", "error"),
) -> tuple[str | None, list[tuple[str, dict]]]:
    """读取 SSE 直到终态事件，返回 run_id 与事件列表。"""
    events: list[tuple[str, dict]] = []
    async with client.stream(
        "POST", "/api/v1/chat/stream", json=payload, headers=headers
    ) as response:
        assert response.status_code == 200, await response.aread()
        assert response.headers["content-type"].startswith("text/event-stream")
        run_id = response.headers.get("X-Run-ID")
        event_name: str | None = None
        async for line in response.aiter_lines():
            if line.startswith("event:"):
                event_name = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
            elif line.startswith("data:") and event_name:
                data = json.loads(line.split(":", 1)[1].strip())
                events.append((event_name, data))
                if event_name in stop_events:
                    return run_id, events
    return run_id, events

"""导出 OpenAPI 契约到 docs/openapi.json，供前端生成类型/核对契约。

用法（二选一，脚本会自行把项目根加入 sys.path）：

    uv run python scripts/export_openapi.py
    .venv/bin/python scripts/export_openapi.py
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

# 直接以 ``python scripts/export_openapi.py`` 运行时，sys.path[0] 是 scripts/，
# 需要显式补上项目根，否则 ``import app`` 失败。
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from app.main import app


def main() -> None:
    target = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "docs" / "openapi.json"
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_text(
        json.dumps(app.openapi(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    print(f"已导出 {target}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# API 契约

- Base URL：`http://localhost:8000`
- 业务前缀：`/api/v1`
- 协议：HTTP + JSON；聊天流式用 SSE
- 文档：FastAPI 自动生成 `/docs`（Swagger）与 `/redoc`
- 状态：M1 / M1.5 / M2 已实现；M3 入站已按 2026-11-10 需求变更取消；M4–M6 待实现

## 1. 通用约定

| 约定 | 规则 |
|---|---|
| 时间 | ISO 8601 UTC，例：`2026-11-04T15:30:00Z` |
| ID | UUID v4 字符串 |
| 字段命名 | `snake_case` |
| 分页 | cursor 分页：`?limit=20&cursor=<opaque>`，响应含 `next_cursor` / `has_more` |
| 幂等 | 写接口可带 `Idempotency-Key` 头；同 key 重复请求返回首次结果 |
| 追踪 | 响应头 `X-Request-ID`；SSE 事件含 `run_id` |
| 内容类型 | 请求/响应 `application/json`；上传 `multipart/form-data`；流式 `text/event-stream` |

### 认证

除注册/登录/健康检查外，所有用户侧接口要求：

```http
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
```

- access token 短期（默认 15 分钟），refresh token 长期（默认 7 天）并旋转；
- 令牌 payload 只放身份（`sub`、`jti`、`exp`），权限从服务端读取；
- 401 表示未认证/令牌过期；403 表示已认证但无权限。

### 错误信封

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "not_found",
    "message": "会话不存在",
    "request_id": "7f3c9a2e..."
  }
}
```

| HTTP | code | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `bad_request` | 参数语义错误 |
| 401 | `unauthorized` | 未登录 / token 无效 |
| 403 | `forbidden` | 无权限 |
| 403 | `capability_disabled` | 能力总开关关闭 |
| 404 | `not_found` | 资源不存在 |
| 409 | `conflict` | 状态冲突（重复审批、并发 run） |
| 413 | `payload_too_large` | 技能包/上传文件超限 |
| 422 | `validation_error` | 请求体校验失败（FastAPI 默认结构会包装为本信封） |
| 422 | `skill_invalid` | 技能包校验失败 |
| 422 | `instruction_too_long` | 指令超过字符上限 |
| 422 | `mcp_transport_not_allowed` | 用户自建 MCP 使用了被禁用的传输 |
| 429 | `rate_limited` | 触发限流 |
| 500 | `internal_error` | 未预期异常 |
| 503 | `service_unavailable` | 依赖服务不可用（M4：Embedding 服务故障时的检索） |
| 503 | `database_unavailable` | 数据库连接不可用（M6；连接/pool 故障） |
| 502 | `a2a_unavailable` | 远程智能体不可用 |
| 502 | `mcp_unreachable` | 显式选择的 MCP 服务器不可达 |
| 504 | `a2a_timeout` | 远程调用超时 |

> M6：启用 Trace 且采样时响应头可能带 `X-Trace-ID`；`X-Request-ID` 始终存在。

## 2. 端点总表

### 2.1 认证
----
### 2.11 指令

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/instructions` | 生效指令、来源（user/system_default）、默认值、上限 |
| PUT | `/api/v1/instructions` | 保存用户指令；`null` 表示恢复默认 |

### 2.12 管理端

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| GET/PUT | `/api/v1/admin/settings/instruction` | 平台默认指令（未实现，随 X2 立项为 M8） |
| GET | `/api/v1/admin/audit-logs` | 全局审计检索（M5） |
| GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE | `/api/v1/admin/secrets[...]` | 平台密钥管理（M5，永不回显明文） |
| GET | `/api/v1/admin/skills` | 系统技能列表（未实现，随 X2 立项为 M8） |
| PUT | `/api/v1/admin/skills/{id}/enabled` | 系统技能启停（未实现，随 X2 立项为 M8） |
| PUT | `/api/v1/admin/skills/{id}/force-disable` | 强制停用（未实现，随 X2 立项为 M8） |

> 表中标注「未实现」的端点属于完整管理控制台（X2），已于 2026-11-11 立项为 **M8**；
> 当前实际可用的 `/admin/*` 只有 `audit-logs` 与 `secrets`。
> 系统 MCP 的 `/admin/mcp/servers*` 接口**当前未实现**（旧文档误列）；M5 只提供密钥本体管理，
> 系统 MCP 的 `secret:` 引用通过运维脚本/数据库配置，管理员自建 MCP 可直接使用。

> 管理端接口要求 `users.role='admin'`，越权返回 403。管理员由运维脚本 `scripts/grant_admin.py` 设置，注册流程不自动提权。

### 2.13 系统

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/healthz` | 存活探针（不查依赖；返回 version/build/env） |
| GET | `/readyz` | 就绪探针（DB/迁移/checkpoint/存储/排水；关键失败 503） |
| GET | `/metrics` | Prometheus 指标（根路径，M6；可用 `METRICS_TOKEN` 保护，关闭时 404） |
| GET | `/api/v1/system/info` | 版本、模型配置、A2A 入站状态、能力开关 |
| GET | `/metrics` | Prometheus 文本指标；不在 OpenAPI schema 中 |

`system/info.a2a` 字段（2026-11-10 起）：

- 本服务只做 A2A 出站 Client，不提供入站 Server；
- `enabled` 恒 `false`，`card_url` / `jsonrpc_url` 恒为空字符串，`auth_type` / `card_security` 恒 `none`；
- 五个字段保留只为兼容前端契约，不表示可被调用的 A2A 地址。

### 2.14 审计日志

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/audit-logs` | 当前用户的审计记录（固定 `actor_type=user` + 自己），支持 `action`、`resource_type`、`start`、`end`、`cursor` |
| GET | `/api/v1/admin/audit-logs` | 管理员全局检索，额外支持 `actor_type`、`actor_id`、`resource_id` |

响应：`{items, next_cursor, has_more}`，按 `created_at DESC, id DESC` 排序；游标不透明。
普通用户访问 `/admin/*` 返回 403。

### 2.15 平台密钥

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/admin/secrets` | 列表（`enabled` 可过滤；只回 name/description/enabled/时间） |
| POST | `/api/v1/admin/secrets` | 创建 `{name,value,description}`；无 `CAPABILITY_SECRET_KEY` → 503 `secret_store_unavailable` |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/admin/secrets/{name}` | 轮换 `value`、改描述或启停 |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/admin/secrets/{name}` | 204；不检查引用 |

`secret:NAME` 引用只允许管理员写入（普通用户 → 422 `secret_ref_not_allowed`），运行时无条件解析；
接口与审计永不回显明文或密文。

## 3. 聊天 SSE 契约
----
### 7.6 分页契约（M1 实测）

四个分页端点共用同一套不透明游标：`GET /conversations`、`GET /conversations/{id}/messages`、
`GET /approvals`、`GET /runs/{id}/events`。

- `next_cursor` 是 urlsafe base64 编码的排序键，前端不得解析、拼接或当作 UUID；
- `has_more=false` 时 `next_cursor=null`，不要继续请求；
- 非法游标返回 422 `validation_error`，不会 500；
- `stats` 是「当前筛选条件下的全量计数」，不是当前页计数；
- 会话排序 `last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC`；消息与审批 `created_at DESC, id DESC`；
  运行事件 `seq ASC`；
- 消息历史 `before` 与 `cursor` 二选一，同时传以 `cursor` 为准；
- 所有时间统一 UTC、序列化以 `Z` 结尾。

> 2026-11-09 热修：此前 cursor 编码把 ORM 的 `UUID` 对象直接交给 `json.dumps`，
> 只要 `has_more=true` 需要生成 `next_cursor` 就会 500。现在编码层统一把
> `UUID` / `datetime` 归一化为字符串，并新增会话/消息/审批分页回归测试。

### 7.7 运行事件回放（`GET /runs/{id}/events`）

| 字段 | 实际行为 |
|---|---|
| `id` | 形如 `<run_id>:<seq>` 的不透明字符串，不是 UUID |
| `seq` | 运行内递增，允许跳号（`message.delta` 不落库） |
| `tokens` | 对象或 `null`，键始终存在 |
| `error` | 字符串摘要或 `null`，不是对象；结构化错误在 `message.done`/`error` 事件里 |
| `payload` | 已剔除内部字段 `_event` |
| 过滤 | `after_seq`、`types`（逗号分隔）、`q`（标题/副标题模糊匹配）、`cursor` |
| 分页 | `after_seq` 与 `cursor` 可同时递增；`has_more=false` 即取完 |

----
### 10.4 前端契约变更清单（M5）

1. 收到 `approval.required` 后，等待 `run.interrupted`（run=`interrupted`），**不会**再收到
   `message.done(finish_reason="interrupted")`；
2. 审批决定后监听 `run.resumed` 与后续 `message.delta`/`message.done`；断线用事件回放**查询**补历史事件，
   逐字续流待 M7 提供 SSE 续流端点；
3. 审批超时：`message.done.finish_reason="canceled"`、`reason="approval_timeout"`；
4. 新端点：`GET /audit-logs`、`GET /admin/audit-logs`、`/admin/secrets` CRUD；
5. 聊天 429：`rate_limited`，`details.retry_after_seconds`；
6. 多审批：每次决定可能返回 `resumed=false` + `resume_error="本轮还有其他审批待处理"`，属正常。

"""技能集成测试：手写创建、zip 导入、文件读取、启停、系统技能只读、越权、聊天激活。"""

from __future__ import annotations

import io
import zipfile

import httpx

from app.db.models.mcp import UserCapabilityOverride
from app.db.session import get_session_factory
from tests.conftest import auth_headers, collect_sse, register_user
from tests.helpers import make_scripted_model


def _skill_zip(slug: str = "my-skill", files: dict[str, bytes] | None = None) -> bytes:
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(buffer, "w") as archive:
        archive.writestr(
            "SKILL.md",
            f"---\nname: {slug}\ndescription: 测试技能\nversion: \"1.0\"\n---\n# 测试技能\n\n1. 第一步；\n2. 第二步。\n".encode(),
        )
        for name, content in (files or {}).items():
            archive.writestr(name, content)
    return buffer.getvalue()


async def test_manual_skill_create_and_update(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])

    created = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/skills",
        json={"name": "会议纪要", "description": "生成会议纪要", "content": "1. 记录议题；2. 输出行动项。"},
        headers=headers,
    )
    assert created.status_code == 201, created.text
    skill = created.json()
    assert skill["scope"] == "user"
    assert skill["source"] == "manual"
    assert skill["effective_enabled"] is True
    assert skill["slug"]

    listing = await client.get("/api/v1/skills", headers=headers)
    body = listing.json()
    assert body["stats"]["user"] == 1
    assert body["stats"]["system"] == 1  # 内置 weekly-report
    assert body["stats"]["enabled"] == 2

    updated = await client.patch(
        f"/api/v1/skills/{skill['id']}",
        json={"description": "生成结构化会议纪要"},
        headers=headers,
    )
    assert updated.status_code == 200
    assert updated.json()["description"] == "生成结构化会议纪要"


async def test_skill_zip_import_with_files(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    raw = _skill_zip("weekly-notes", {"references/template.md": "# 模板\n\n- 议题\n- 结论".encode()})
    imported = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/skills/import",
        files={"file": ("weekly-notes.zip", io.BytesIO(raw), "application/zip")},
        headers=headers,
    )
    assert imported.status_code == 201, imported.text
    skill = imported.json()
    assert skill["slug"] == "weekly-notes"
    assert skill["source"] == "upload"
    assert skill["file_count"] == 1
    assert skill["name"] == "测试技能"  # 正文首个 H1
    assert [item["path"] for item in skill["files"]] == ["references/template.md"]

    files = await client.get(f"/api/v1/skills/{skill['id']}/files", headers=headers)
    assert files.status_code == 200
    assert files.json()[0]["path"] == "references/template.md"

    content = await client.get(
        f"/api/v1/skills/{skill['id']}/files/references/template.md", headers=headers
    )
    assert content.status_code == 200
    assert "模板" in content.json()["content"]

    traversal = await client.get(
        f"/api/v1/skills/{skill['id']}/files/..%2F..%2Fetc%2Fpasswd", headers=headers
    )
    assert traversal.status_code in (404, 422)

    # 同名 slug 再导 → 409
    duplicate = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/skills/import",
        files={"file": ("weekly-notes.zip", io.BytesIO(raw), "application/zip")},
        headers=headers,
    )
    assert duplicate.status_code == 409


async def test_skill_import_rejects_invalid_zip(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    bad = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/skills/import",
        files={"file": ("bad.zip", io.BytesIO(b"not a zip"), "application/zip")},
        headers=headers,
    )
    assert bad.status_code == 422
    assert bad.json()["error"]["code"] == "skill_invalid"


async def test_system_skill_readonly_and_override(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    listing = await client.get("/api/v1/skills", headers=headers)
    system_skill = next(item for item in listing.json()["items"] if item["scope"] == "system")
    assert system_skill["slug"] == "weekly-report"

    # 系统技能不可改/删
    assert (
        await client.patch(
            f"/api/v1/skills/{system_skill['id']}", json={"name": "hack"}, headers=headers
        )
    ).status_code == 403
    assert (
        await client.delete(f"/api/v1/skills/{system_skill['id']}", headers=headers)
    ).status_code == 403

    # 停用系统技能 → 写用户覆盖表，effective_enabled=false
    disabled = await client.put(
        f"/api/v1/skills/{system_skill['id']}/enabled", json={"enabled": False}, headers=headers
    )
    assert disabled.status_code == 200
    assert disabled.json()["effective_enabled"] is False

    async with get_session_factory()() as db:
        override = await db.get(
            UserCapabilityOverride, (registered["user"]["id"], "skill", system_skill["id"])
        )
        assert override is not None and override.enabled is False

"""MCP 集成测试：CRUD、健康检查与工具发现、审批策略、越权与聊天工具调用。"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json

import httpx

from app.modules.mcp.service import register_test_transport
from tests.conftest import auth_headers, collect_sse, register_user
from tests.helpers import (
    MOCK_TOOL_READ,
    MOCK_TOOL_WRITE,
    make_mcp_transport,
    make_scripted_model,
)

MOCK_URL = "https://mcp.example.com/mcp"


def _register_mock(tools: list[dict]) -> None:
    register_test_transport(MOCK_URL, make_mcp_transport(tools))


async def _create_server(client: httpx.AsyncClient, auth: dict, **overrides) -> dict:
    payload = {
        "name": "测试 MCP",
        "slug": "test-mcp",
        "transport": "streamable_http",
        "url": MOCK_URL,
        **overrides,
    }
    response = await client.post("/api/v1/mcp/servers", json=payload, headers=auth)
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    return response.json()


async def test_create_server_discovers_tools(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    _register_mock([MOCK_TOOL_READ, MOCK_TOOL_WRITE])
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])

    server = await _create_server(client, headers)
    assert server["scope"] == "user"
    assert server["health_status"] == "healthy"
    assert server["tool_count"] == 2
    assert server["effective_enabled"] is True

    tools = await client.get(f"/api/v1/mcp/servers/{server['id']}/tools", headers=headers)
    assert tools.status_code == 200
    rows = {item["name"]: item for item in tools.json()}
    assert rows["search"]["risk"] == "read"
    assert rows["search"]["requires_approval"] is False
    assert rows["search"]["exposed_name"] == "mcp__test-mcp__search"
    assert rows["create_issue"]["requires_approval"] is True
    assert rows["create_issue"]["risk"] == "unknown"

    listing = await client.get("/api/v1/mcp/servers", headers=headers)
    assert listing.json()["stats"]["user"] == 1
    assert listing.json()["stats"]["healthy"] == 1

    available = await client.get("/api/v1/mcp/available", headers=headers)
    assert available.json()["items"][0]["slug"] == "test-mcp"


async def test_check_and_refresh_tools(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    _register_mock([MOCK_TOOL_READ])
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    server = await _create_server(client, headers)

    checked = await client.post(f"/api/v1/mcp/servers/{server['id']}/check", headers=headers)
    assert checked.status_code == 200
    assert checked.json()["health_status"] == "healthy"
    assert checked.json()["tools_discovered"] == 1

    refreshed = await client.post(
        f"/api/v1/mcp/servers/{server['id']}/refresh-tools", headers=headers
    )
    assert refreshed.status_code == 200
    assert refreshed.json()["tools_discovered"] == 1


async def test_server_enable_disable_and_delete(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    _register_mock([MOCK_TOOL_READ])
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    server = await _create_server(client, headers)

    disabled = await client.put(
        f"/api/v1/mcp/servers/{server['id']}/enabled", json={"enabled": False}, headers=headers
    )
    assert disabled.json()["effective_enabled"] is False
    enabled = await client.put(
        f"/api/v1/mcp/servers/{server['id']}/enabled", json={"enabled": True}, headers=headers
    )
    assert enabled.json()["effective_enabled"] is True

    deleted = await client.delete(f"/api/v1/mcp/servers/{server['id']}", headers=headers)
    assert deleted.status_code == 204
    assert (
        await client.get(f"/api/v1/mcp/servers/{server['id']}", headers=headers)
    ).status_code == 404


async def test_tool_patch_policy(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    _register_mock([MOCK_TOOL_READ, MOCK_TOOL_WRITE])
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    server = await _create_server(client, headers)
    tools = (await client.get(f"/api/v1/mcp/servers/{server['id']}/tools", headers=headers)).json()
    write_tool = next(item for item in tools if item["name"] == "create_issue")

    # 未知风险工具可关闭审批
    patched = await client.patch(
        f"/api/v1/mcp/tools/{write_tool['id']}",
        json={"requires_approval": False, "enabled": False},
        headers=headers,
    )
    assert patched.status_code == 200

"""远程 Agent 集成测试：preview / 注册 / 列表 / 详情 / PATCH / refresh / health / 删除 + SSRF。"""

from __future__ import annotations

import httpx

from app.modules.a2a.client import register_test_transport
from tests.conftest import auth_headers, register_user
from tests.fixtures.fake_a2a_agent import FakeA2aAgent

AGENT_URL = "http://a2a.test"


def _register_fake(
    *, streaming: bool = False, requires_approval: bool = False, name: str = "Fake Agent"
) -> FakeA2aAgent:
    fake = FakeA2aAgent(
        name=name,
        url=AGENT_URL,
        streaming=streaming,
        requires_approval=requires_approval,
    )
    register_test_transport(AGENT_URL, httpx.ASGITransport(app=fake.app))
    return fake


async def _create_agent(client: httpx.AsyncClient, headers: dict, **overrides) -> dict:
    payload = {"url": AGENT_URL, **overrides}

async def test_admin_crud_and_no_plaintext(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient, admin: User, admin_auth: dict[str, str]
) -> None:
    created = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/admin/secrets",
        json={"name": "DATA_AGENT_KEY", "value": "super-secret-value", "description": "远程代理"},
        headers=admin_auth,
    )
    assert created.status_code == 201
    body = created.json()
    assert body["name"] == "DATA_AGENT_KEY"
    assert "value" not in body and "ciphertext" not in body
    assert "super-secret-value" not in created.text

    listed = await client.get("/api/v1/admin/secrets", headers=admin_auth)
    assert listed.status_code == 200
    assert listed.json()["items"][0]["name"] == "DATA_AGENT_KEY"
    assert "super-secret-value" not in listed.text

    patched = await client.patch(
        "/api/v1/admin/secrets/DATA_AGENT_KEY",
        json={"value": "rotated-value", "enabled": False},
        headers=admin_auth,
    )
    assert patched.status_code == 200
    assert patched.json()["enabled"] is False

    async with get_session_factory()() as session:
